title: Customer success Manager
jobDescription:
App Zen is the leader in Finance AI software built to deliver autonomous processing for modern finance teams. Our patented artificial intelligence software uses deep learning, semantic analysis, and computer vision to accurately and efficiently process intelligence from thousands of data sources, documents, and images so that organizations can better understand financial transactions and make smarter business decisions. Over 1,000 global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use App Zen's Expense Audit and Autonomous AP products to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their business. Visit us at www.appzen.com and follow us on Linked In. Are you a Procure-to-Pay (P2P) expert who loves building relationships, driving adoption, and turning complex AP operations into measurable value? We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of Fortune 500 Accounts Payable customers and act as their trusted P2P advisor
- helping them get the most out of App Zen's Autonomous AP platform.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
● Serve as a strategic advisor to customers by driving adoption, optimizing configuration, and aligning App Zen's AP automation solutions with business goals. ● Manage multiple customer engagements using strong project management practices, including regular status updates, adoption plans, and action tracking. ● Provide functional and technical expertise across App Zen's accounts payable and invoice automation capabilities, including support for major releases and platform enablement. ● Deliver compelling, data-driven insights to identify opportunities for improvement and enhance customer value realization to improve autonomous rates. ● Collaborate with internal teams and forge strong customer relationships to support growth, self-sufficiency, and long-term success. ● Own a portfolio of enterprise Accounts Payable customers as the primary post-sales relationship owner – driving adoption, value realization, retention, and renewal. ● Drive Business and Value Reviews with customers, representing value realization metrics, expansion opportunities, and scalability avenues. ● Ensure governance and compliance for steady-state account transitions, including systematic Knowledge Transfer from Implementation teams. ● Run regular cadences with customer teams; forecast arising problems, flag issues and concerns ahead of time, and prepare solutions in advance to avoid escalations. ● Proactively monitor and report on operational health metrics (adoption, SLA reports, CSI) to internal and external stakeholders to identify and mitigate risk. ● Drive and coordinate RCAs and high-severity issues in close collaboration with PMG, Engineering, and the Global Support organization. Must-Have : ● Strong Procure-to-Pay (P2P) background – deep, hands-on understanding of the end to-end lifecycle across procurement, invoice processing, AP operations, and payments, with working knowledge of how AR operates and intersects with AP. This role is specific to individuals with genuine P2P experience. ● 10+ years in accounts payable, finance, or invoice processing, with a strong preference for hands-on AP operations background. ● Knowledge of financial taxonomy and tax logic – GST rate calculations, tax codes, and jurisdictional treatment. ● Geo Experience
- Experience in working across geos, adapting to different AP practices, compliance, and tax regimes globally, and comfortable operating across time zones. ● Hands-on knowledge of major ERP systems – SAP and Oracle at a minimum; familiarity with additional P2P / procurement platforms (Coupa, Ariba, etc.) strongly preferred. ● Demonstrated understanding of multi-vendor dynamics in P2P – how multiple ERPs, procurement suites, and AP automation tools coexist and interact in large enterprise landscapes. ● Experience with Saa S solutions- software configuration, and product demonstrations; familiarity with financial/accounting and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). ● Proficiency in AI tools
- (Gemini, Claude, Notebook) and Excel, with a goal-oriented, collaborative, curious, and adaptable approach. ● Proven client management skills; able to drive continuous improvement and thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. ● Communication Skills
- ○ Strong communication, organizational skills, attention to detail, and a passion for problem-solving; logical and thorough understanding of the AP and T&E process. ○ Exceptional customer presence and presentation skills; comfortable with C-level executives and liaising across cross-functional teams. Nice-to-Have : ● Consulting experience (Big 4, management consulting, or finance-transformation practice) is a strong added bonus. ● Exposure to AP automation, invoice audit, or Finance AI platforms. ● Experience supporting Fortune 500 / global enterprise customers with operational hubs (GBS/GCC) We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. apply for this job App Zen, Inc. Home Page Jobs powered by

title: Implementation Success Manager
jobDescription: App Zen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use App Zen's invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. At App Zen, we value candidates who are actively using AI tools to enhance productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and solve problems more efficiently. Across all roles, we are looking for team members who leverage AI in meaningful ways to drive impact in their work. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com . Roles & Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end deployment of the solution (across all modules, functionalities, and integration points, and people/change management topics in scope), manage the roadmap, and report into the global steering committee. Build trustworthy relationships to effectively communicate and work with customer/internal teams/stakeholders. Oversee global/regional TE policy or template development if multi-country deployment and in program scope. Drive the requirement gathering and documentation. Evaluate complex customer business requirements gathered by the Implementation Consultants following Fin Trans proved and consistent methodology. Manage the development and review functional documentation, such as TE policies and process documentation, CDW (conceptual design), and technicalintegration design. Independently drive the product configuration according to customer business requirements while considering functional and technical dependencies. Gathering of detailed integration related requirements/inputs from the Fin Trans team customer and translate customer requirements into application design (according to customer needs and the respective scope of implementation). Act hands-on in complex technical configurations of and conduct functional reviews of configurations completed by Implementation/Functional Consultants. Manage UAT related test result evaluation and bug-fixing. Manage and maintain cut-over plan (business and technical) Deliver on SLA and commitments under time and budget pressure, incl. updating project tracking systems and fulfilling administrative responsibilities. Desired personal profile: analytical, inquisitive, service & team-oriented, friendly demeanour, early adopter. Ideal Candidate Must Have 8+ years of experience in implementing Saas products or other relevant business consulting. In-depth knowledge of AP/P2P function A strong leader who can mentor and loves to develop people. Strong project management skills Exceptional customer presence and presentation skills; comfortable in talking with C-level executives. Ability to liaise with multiple internal cross-functional teams. title: Netsuite Integration Specialist
jobDescription:
About Us: App Zen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use App Zen's invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com . Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Architecture & Design: Lead the design and delivery of complex Net Suite integrations using Suite Talk (REST/SOAP), Suite Script (1.0/2.0), and RESTlets. AI Integration: Define how App Zen’s AI-powered invoice capture and coding sync back to Net Suite to create bill records autonomously every 15 minutes. Data Governance: Design automatic, bi-directional syncs for master data—including custom fields, cost centers, and tax codes—ensuring 100% data integrity. Technical Advisory: Act as the primary technical advisor during implementation, guiding Fortune 500 stakeholders through complex configuration decisions and integration patterns. Standardization: Develop reusable integration frameworks and standards to reduce custom development, accelerating time-to-value for customers. Troubleshooting: Lead L3 support for complex integration issues, managing performance monitoring and bug-fixing during UAT and Hypercare. Required Qualification :

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience: 8+ years in IT integration architecture, with at least 5+ years specializing in Net Suite. Net Suite Mastery: Deep expertise in Suite Cloud tools (Suite Script, Suite Talk, Suite Flow, Suite Builder) and Net Suite financial modules (P2P, AP, General Ledger). Middleware Proficiency: Hands-on experience with i Paa S platforms like Celigo, Boomi, or Workato for orchestrating complex Saa S ecosystems. Fintech Knowledge: Strong understanding of "Record-to-Report" (R2R) and "Procure-to-Pay" (P2P) workflows. Security: Solid grasp of data privacy (GDPR), encryption, and secure API authentication (OAuth 2.0). Preferred Skills : Certifications: Net Suite Certified Suite Cloud Developer or ERP Consultant. AI Interest: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and how they transform traditional ERP workflows. Communication: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for C-level executives. title: Salesforce Developer
jobDescription:
App Zen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Leveraging patented artificial intelligence, we accurately and efficiently process data from numerous sources, enabling organizations to gain deep insights into enterprise spend, drive smarter business decisions, and seamlessly integrate with existing financial workflows. Trusted by global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, App Zen delivers accelerated processing times, reduced fraud, and optimized financial operations. Visit us at www.appzen.com . Role Overview: The Salesforce Developer will join App Zen and will be responsible for the overall design, implementation, and support of solutions in the Salesforce.com environment. This requires the ability to develop and support applications using Sales Cloud, Lightning Platform, APEX, Visual Force, Chatter and the Force.com platform Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, MIS/CIS or equivalent work experience. 7+ years of Salesforce.com development experience. At least one large Salesforce implementation project involving multiple releases, change management process, and/or multi-locale deployment. Knowledge of APEX, Visual Force, Salesforce APIs, SOAP or REST based web services, and SOQL Experience with integrating Net Suite, Conga, Docusign with Salesforce, automation of quote-to-cash process. Excellent knowledge of integration design and development best practices, governor limits, code reviews. Experience designing test plans, performing unit testing, and writing test classes to ensure proper code coverage. Experience with Java, MATLAB, Python, HTML or other languages is a plus. Platform developer certification I and II are preferred and Admin certification is a plus.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, implement and deploy Salesforce.com based cloud application solutions to internal business teams within App Zen. Gather business requirements and translate them into Salesforce changes and enhancements along with technical documentation. Build business logic into visual workflows, focused on positive user experience. Provide technical support to ensure that the application is effectively implemented & managed across our Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success Groups. Provide technical design, integration architecture, and solution recommendations. Create and manage custom objects, fields, formulas, validation rules, custom workflow and approval processes. Partner with internal teams, third party vendors to develop consistent solutions and functional integrations. Responsible for design and code review, and release management. We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. title: Senior Revenue Accountant
jobDescription:
About App Zen App Zen is an AI-first automation platform for finance teams, covering the full spend-to-pay lifecycle
- from invoice processing and expense auditing to accounts payable and corporate card review. Our AI platform integrates with customers' existing systems to reduce manual effort, errors, fraud, and compliance risk, giving finance and accounting teams the tools to operate more strategically and scale without adding headcount. As a member of the Finance team, the Senior Revenue Accountant will own operational revenue accounting and compliance at App Zen,. This role reviews, analyzes, and approves customer contracts and revenue arrangements under ASC 606, drives the month-end revenue close, and partners closely with AR & Collections, Deal Desk, GTM, and FP&A to ensure revenue, deferred revenue, and receivable balances are accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, motivated, and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is initially an individual contributor role, with the expectation that it will grow into a managerial position as the Revenue Accounting function scales.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Manage daily revenue accounting operations — review, analyze, and approve customer contracts using the ASC 606 framework and company policy for revenue recognition. • Review and approve revenue arrangements for allocations, concessions, and similar items to ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC
606. • Perform the month-end revenue close process, including revenue-related account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables. • Perform quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326, and partner with the AR & Collections Lead to develop and report key AR metrics for management reporting. • Work closely with the AR team to resolve complex AR and collections issues. • Perform regular month-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue and accounts receivable balances to support financial integrity and management decision-making. • Perform and maintain the annual SSP (standalone selling price) analysis, including management of the item master and fair value records. • Collaborate cross-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, and AR teams to resolve issues. • Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including implementation, testing, and optimization. • Prepare audit schedules and assist with coordination of the year-end audit with external auditors. • Maintain the highest documentation standards. • Partner with FP&A to provide inputs for revenue forecasts as needed. • Prepare detailed revenue packages for management and the audit committee/Board as requested. • Participate in special projects as they arise. What you need : • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. • Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles. • 7+ years of experience in revenue accounting, and full-cycle accounts receivable, ideally for Saa S companies. • Knowledge of US GAAP revenue accounting, specifically revenue from customer contracts (ASC 606), is required. • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage effectively through ambiguity and complexity. • Consistently meets deadlines, prioritizes appropriately, and remains flexible. • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace applications. • Highly motivated, energetic self-starter and strategic thinker. • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build relationships within and outside the Finance team. • Experience with Net Suite ERP, Net Suite ARM, and Salesforce is required. Things That Make a Difference : ● Familiarity with US sales tax regulations and requirements. ● Proven expertise managing full-cycle accounts receivable processes. ● Knowledge of Order Processing. ● Hands-on experience navigating customer procurement portals, including Coupa and Ariba.
